purpose: The controlled list of data streams. MSEL observed_in entries, stream generators, validators and the knowledge graph use these stream_id values and no others.
rules: A delivered stream covers at least its required_span and carries the truth from the moment it happens, with no column or note that explains it.
Entity ids in a stream come from the registries listed in ids_from_registry.
Streams with coordinates must pass scripts/check_geo.py (see 99_reference/geo/position_rules.json).
What each event should look like in each stream is in 00_scenario/canon_timeline.json under expected_observations.

streams.name: AIS vessel positions
streams.format: USCG NAIS / MarineCadastre CSV
streams.cadence: about 1 min in channels and harbours, 5 min in open bay and approaches, 6 min at anchor, 15 min on station, 30 min offshore, 60 min moored
streams.notes: Positions must pass scripts/check_geo.py. Static fields carry real identifiers; no explanatory columns. Extra column Destination (the transponder's free-text field).

additional_files.what: satellite-received AIS (same columns, 30-60 min cadence); kept apart because it is a different receiver

streams.name: Port radar and camera contact log
streams.format: Radar track table (sensor id, track id, time, position, speed, course, AIS-correlated flag, correlated MMSI) and camera event log
streams.cadence: radar tracks every 1-2 min while a contact is held; camera events as they occur; sensor status rows hourly
streams.notes: Carries hulls that AIS does not: the dark vessel during its AIS gap, the unidentified hull off the entrance channel, the tankers alongside the berth. Sensors go offline in the storm and return on the dates in the canon timeline. Five tables: sensors, radar_tracks_*, camera_events, vessel_traffic_log, sensor_status. Sensors are in sensor_registry.json (port_surveillance_sensors).

streams.name: Coast Guard port conditions and channel status
streams.format: Captain of the Port order log (MSIB style): effective time, condition, channel segment, status, restrictions
streams.notes: segment_id values are defined in terminal_registry.json (channel_segments).

streams.name: Vessel arrivals and departures
streams.format: USCG eNOAD / CBP ACE normalized
streams.notes: port_of_arrival is USCRP. Columns include next_port, noa_submitted_datetime, eta_revised_datetime, ata_anchorage_datetime, hold_log, shift_berth_id, shift_datetime; agents are in organizations.json (type 'ship agent').

streams.name: Cargo manifests (sea and air relief cargo)
streams.format: CBP ACE manifest normalized
streams.notes: Sea and air consignments in one table (mode SEA / AIR).

streams.name: Fuel deliveries and lots
streams.format: Delivery ticket log: time, supplier, receiving facility, product, volume, lot id, carrier (truck or barge)
streams.notes: One ledger of delivery tickets and tank dips for generator and fleet fuel (record_type DELIVERY or TANK_DIP); contract_id and ticket ids agree with payments/contracts_invoices.csv.

streams.name: ADS-B aircraft positions
streams.format: OpenSky StateVector CSV plus nic and nac_p integrity columns
streams.cadence: 10 s near airfields and in hovers, 30 s low level, 60 s en route
streams.notes: No covert drone ever appears here. GPS interference shows as degraded nic/nac_p values and position jumps. nic and nac_p integrity fields are reported; call signs carry at most eight characters (join on icao24).

streams.name: Drone detections and authorizations
streams.format: Radar/RF detection tracks (sensor, track, time, position, altitude, RCS, RF signature), LAANC authorization list, sighting reports
streams.cadence: 1-5 s while tracked; sensor status rows hourly
streams.notes: Hostile drones are seen only here (and in social posts and 911 calls), never with an authorization. Five tables: sensor_sites, sensor_status_*, detections_*, laanc_authorizations, sighting_reports. Sensors are in sensor_registry.json (drone_detection_sensors).

streams.name: Authorized drone flight telemetry
streams.format: DJI SRT normalized to CSV

additional_files.what: flight log and thermal survey readings (different columns)

streams.name: Satellite scene catalogue
streams.format: STAC v1.0.0 Item JSON with detection summaries
streams.notes: Includes catalog.json (STAC collection). Vessel counts in scene descriptions come from the AIS files: re-run gen_satellite.py after AIS is regenerated.

streams.name: Structure damage assessments and flood/debris extents
streams.format: FEMA GDA feature table

streams.name: Response vehicle locations
streams.format: AVL log: time, unit, position, speed, heading, status, incident
streams.cadence: see 06_data_streams/schemas/avl_schema.json (denser while moving, sparse when parked)
streams.notes: Vehicles drive door to door on the street network (every Census local road in the area); parked units sit off the centreline. check_geo vehicle rule: moving fixes within 30 m of a street.

streams.name: 911 computer-aided dispatch records
streams.format: Tyler New World CAD export with ANI/ALI class and call metadata

additional_files.what: call-centre daily volume, queue depth, shift log, subscriber records (no coordinates)

streams.name: Search and rescue mission log
streams.format: Mission log: agency, asset, launch and recovery times, location, persons rescued, method
streams.notes: One row per rescue case; mission_id groups a sortie. Helicopter sorties are the same flights that appear in adsb (join asset_id to aircraft_registry.json registration). delivered_to / delivered_utc name the shelter, hospital pad or airfield where survivors were handed over (see shelters/shelter_intake_log.csv). Folder also holds sar_asset_log.csv, flood_depth_soundings.csv and flood_extent_snapshots.csv.

streams.name: Shelter registry and daily census
streams.format: Registry (facility, open and close times) and daily occupancy
streams.notes: shelter_daily_census.csv (one row per shelter per day) plus shelter_registry.csv, shelter_intake_log.csv (arrivals by mode, including search-and-rescue deliveries; daily sums equal new_arrivals), shelter_211_calls.csv and evacuation_bus_trips.csv.

streams.name: Public alerts (EAS, WEA, city and county notices)
streams.format: IPAWS CAP alert log with separate English and Spanish release times

streams.name: Broadcast and translation logs
streams.format: Station programme log (time, station, item, language, alert id) and translation job log (source received, translation delivered)
streams.cadence: one row per aired item or job

streams.name: Social media posts
streams.format: Twitter v1.1 Tweet objects
streams.notes: Files whose names start with an underscore are not posts: _account_lookup.jsonl, _platform_records_return.jsonl, _geotagged_index.csv.

additional_files.what: index of geo-tagged posts (id_str, screen_name, created_utc, latitude, longitude)

streams.name: News stories
streams.format: Story objects (also served by the newsroom feeds)

streams.name: Official statements and notices
streams.format: Public fields of the public record: date, time, issuer, type, text
streams.notes: Export of 02_public_record without event or thread links. Record ids are public-record fact ids plus three NOTICE-* records for events with no fact of their own.

streams.name: Surface weather and buoy observations
streams.format: NOAA LCD / ASOS CSV; NDBC standard meteorological

streams.name: Hurricane advisories and best track
streams.format: NHC advisory list and HURDAT2 best track

streams.name: Tide and river gauges
streams.format: NOAA CO-OPS water level; USGS stage and discharge
streams.cadence: 6 min tide, 15 min river; the bay gauge is offline D0 to D+5

streams.name: Water-quality sondes
streams.format: TCEQ sonde table

streams.name: Air-quality monitors
streams.format: EPA AQS hourly

streams.name: Wastewater pathogen surveillance
streams.format: CDC NWSS style: sample date, sewershed, target, concentration

streams.name: Emergency department visits
streams.format: CDC NSSP BioSense line list

streams.name: Hospital capacity and utilities status
streams.format: HHS Protect daily capacity plus power source, generator fuel and diversion status

streams.name: Syndromic surveillance summary
streams.format: Daily counts by syndrome, facility and area

streams.name: Utility SCADA historian
streams.format: AVEVA PI style tag history
streams.cadence: compressed archive: a row on change beyond deadband, at least hourly (15 min for key pressures and voltages); events at the exact second
streams.notes: No attack-labelling columns.

streams.name: Customer outages by area
streams.format: Outage management export: time, area or feeder, customers served, customers out
streams.notes: Adds cause, crews_assigned, est_restoration_utc.

streams.name: Maintenance work orders and purchase requests
streams.format: IBM Maximo WORKORDER export, several organisations

streams.name: Military installation status reports
streams.format: Daily status: installation, readiness percent, aircraft on station, backup power status, perimeter sensor status

streams.name: Utility security alerts
streams.format: SIEM alert queue export with analyst disposition
streams.notes: Monthly alert files plus rule_changes.csv and daily_summary.csv. Starts 2027-07-16.

streams.name: Network connection logs
streams.format: Zeek conn, dns and notice TSV with OT protocol notices
streams.cadence: one folder per UTC day: conn, dns, ssl, notice
streams.notes: Background flows are sampled 1 in 200; flows involving hosts with alerts or remote sessions are complete. dns.log rows share their uid with the UDP/53 row in conn.log. Endpoints are in id.orig_h / id.resp_h. External addresses and names are invented. Starts 2027-07-16.

streams.name: Host, access and mail audit logs
streams.format: VPN sessions, historian access, file and configuration audit, change tickets, mail gateway, endpoint detections, by organisation

key_columns.time: time_utc (login_utc / start_utc in the session tables)

streams.notes: Sixteen tables: remote-access sessions, historian access, device configuration changes, SCADA command log, alarm-suppression audit, file integrity, change management, settings audits, endpoint protection, mail gateways and follow-on logons.

streams.name: Aid portal and logistics system access logs
streams.format: Web authentication log: time, system, account hash, source address and ASN, result
streams.cadence: per attempt (aggregated per minute during floods)
streams.notes: aid_portal_access_YYYY-MM.csv and base_logistics_access_YYYY-MM.csv; account_ref is the applications stream's account_id for real accounts. Registration opens 2027-11-13T06:00Z (midnight local); before that the aid portal serves information pages only.

streams.name: Tanker cargo-control and vendor remote-access logs
streams.format: Cargo-control event log (valves, alarms, tank levels) and vendor remote-session log
streams.cadence: events as they occur; tank levels every 5 min
streams.notes: Three files: kalvora_star, ostrel_bay, remote_sessions.

streams.name: Vendor registry, contracts and invoices
streams.format: Vendor registry, award records (PIID), invoices
streams.notes: Six files: vendor_registry, business_filings, awards, invoices, actions, debris_monitoring.

streams.name: Financial transactions
streams.format: ACH and card transaction log
streams.notes: counterparty_id may be an organizations.json id as well as an entity_registry id.

streams.name: Disaster aid applications and account changes
streams.format: Application records and account-change audit (deposit detail changes)
streams.notes: Time columns submitted_utc, changed_utc, event_utc; ids application_id, account_id, area_id, tract. Registration opens 2027-11-13T06:00Z (midnight local, D+60).

streams.name: Insurance and spill damage claims
streams.format: ACORD claim records
streams.notes: Filed dates follow a rising curve from D0; policy changes before the storm are in the same file. policy_id holds the registry's policy_number; two record types (policy_transaction, claim).

streams.name: Census tract table
streams.format: ACS 5-year estimates

required_span.note: reference table; rows carry their own dates where relevant

streams.notes: The tract index carries AREA_ID, EVAC_ZONE_AREA_ID and WATER_DISTRICT_AREA_ID for joins to areas.json.

streams.name: GPS interference reports
streams.not_delivered_reason: Carried by the nic and nac_p columns in adsb and by the FAA notice in public_record; a separate file would only restate them.

streams.name: Navy ordnance disposal and mine-countermeasures logs
streams.not_delivered_reason: Operational military records; the search is visible through ais (search-pattern tracks), port_conditions and public_record.

streams.name: 311 and information-line calls
streams.not_delivered_reason: Only daily totals matter and those are reported in public_record and news; no thread joins on call-level data.

streams.name: Highway traffic counts
streams.not_delivered_reason: No canon event depends on it; evacuation load is visible in avl and news.

streams.name: Grid operator (ERCOT) logs
streams.not_delivered_reason: Outside the utility's own records; the same load loss is in scada_historian and outage_map.

streams.name: Case files, after-action reports and internal memoranda
streams.not_delivered_reason: These are conclusions, not evidence. Their public parts are in public_record and news.

streams.name: Hospital internal logs (handoffs, lab systems, supply manifests)
streams.not_delivered_reason: Patient-level internal records beyond the ed_visits line list; the needed signals are in ed_visits, hospital_capacity, syndromic and fuel_deliveries.

streams.name: Spill response field and model logs
streams.not_delivered_reason: Response-team working files; the spill's movement is observable in water_quality, air_quality, satellite and drone_telemetry.

audience: Internal (game master). It lists which threads rely on each stream; do not hand this file to participants. Give them the schema files in 06_data_streams/schemas/ instead.
